stature.basis: Artistic body variation; no personal measurement located.

basis: No verified individual portrait is available. This is a distinct, seeded reconstruction, not a likeness. Skin, eye and hair colours, stature and build are artistic choices, not demographic facts or measurements. No ancestry is inferred from a surname or photograph. The body and clothes are selected from the recorded household role; exact clothes are a liberty. Stature is interpolated between approved child and teen engineering bodies, with small individual variation; adult aging and body-build targets are disabled.
